package.description: Rovo Desktop is the best way to access Rovo from your Windows or macOS device. It's a dedicated spot to chat, manage agents, and complete tasks while staying connected to your workplace knowledge.

en-US.description: Rovo Desktop is the best way to access Rovo from your Windows or macOS device. It's a dedicated spot to chat, manage agents, and complete tasks while staying connected to your workplace knowledge.
en-US.longDescription:
Rovo Desktop is the best way to access Rovo from your Windows or macOS device. It's a dedicated spot to chat, manage agents, and complete tasks while staying connected to your workplace knowledge.
Once you're logged in, you can start using Rovo Desktop right away. Start a chat and ask a question about your project or company policies, open Agents from the chat menu and run a go-to task, start a task by navigating to the Max tab, or select Add (+) to add extra context to your prompts from any apps you're running.
en-US.name: Rovo

登录后即可立即开始使用 Rovo Desktop：发起聊天，询问有关项目或公司政策的问题；从聊天菜单打开智能体并运行即用型任务；前往 Max 选项卡启动复杂的多步骤任务；或点击添加 (+) 为您正在运行的任何应用中的提示添加上下文。
